packages.name: core
packages.description: Platform-neutral ports, container and shared runtime types.

packages.name: adapters
packages.description: Platform and infrastructure implementations for core ports.

packages.name: ui
packages.description: Reusable feature UI and shared UI components.

packages.name: app-shell
packages.description: Application wiring shells that compose UI, domains and adapters.

rules.reason: Core must stay platform-neutral and cannot depend on upper layers.
Domains must not depend on platform adapters, UI or app shells.
Adapters implement ports and cannot depend on UI or app shells.
UI packages must not import platform adapters directly.
UI-to-domain imports are legacy coupling to burn down through core ports.
